The '''First Twelve''' is used for the senior [[Wavemistress]]es or [[Sailmistress]]es present in any gathering.  The First Twelve Sailmistresses of a Clan chose the Wavemistress. The First Twelve Wavemistresses elect the [[Mistress of the Ships]].
